entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: An orphaned Imperial student with telekinesis who befriends the emperor, is disbelieved about the man with the metal arm, and leaves the palace to hunt the man with the metal arm.

entities.name: Eiko Shizuki
entities.description: Kaito's sister, the same age as him, who chooses to study as a kami diplomat.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: A seven-tailed kitsune who teaches Kaito and Eiko and serves as the emperor's advisor.

entities.name: Swift-Arm
entities.description: A kitsune in Imperial armor who runs the elite Golden-Tail Academy for Imperial samurai.

entities.name: The Emperor of Kamigawa
entities.description: A snow-white-haired girl who rules Kamigawa, forbidden from revealing her name, and who befriends Kaito behind a screen door.

entities.name: Katsumasa
entities.description: A moonfolk Futurist who gives Kaito an origami crane drone and invites him to join the Futurists.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The guardian spirit of Kamigawa, a vast golden-armed kami with three masks, who speaks only through the emperor.

entities.name: Man with the metal arm
entities.description: A chrome-armored intruder with a purple-glowing metal claw arm and pink eyes who takes the emperor.

entities.name: Kami of Imperial Dishware
entities.description: A salamander-shaped kami floating teacups in the palace kitchen's basin.

entities.name: Kami of Spring Blossoms
entities.description: A kami that took offense when Kaito trampled a flower bed.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: The first emperor to channel with Kyodai, represented by the masks on Kyodai's face.

entities.name: Golden-Tail Academy
entities.description: The elite academy for Imperial samurai run by Swift-Arm.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The ruling order of Kamigawa that regulates technology and kami relations.

entities.name: Futurists
entities.description: Technologists from the floating city of Otawara chafing under Imperial regulation of technology.

entities.name: Uprisers
entities.description: Rumored rebels in the mountains of Sokenzan City, blamed at first for the intrusion.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane whose mortal and spirit realms are merging.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: The Imperial city and palace where Kaito and Eiko live.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: The metropolitan center where Kaito's parents worked in a lab.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: The Futurists' floating city.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: A diminished forest fiercely guarded by kami.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: The district of Towashi where radiation med-tech is unaffordable.

events.summary: Kaito sneaks into the palace kitchen and uses telekinesis to steal blue mochi, escaping a cook after breaking dishes.
events.quote: Two pieces of mochi floated up in the air, hovering inches above the table.

events.summary: Kaito shares a mochi with Eiko in the sparring room before Light-Paws arrives.
Light-Paws announces Kaito and Eiko will no longer be sparring partners, because Eiko has chosen to study as a kami diplomat.
events.quote: Eiko has chosen to study as a kami diplomat.

events.summary: Kaito recalls how he first befriended the emperor, speaking to her behind a screen door without knowing who she was.
events.quote: Kaito hadn't known it was the emperor.

events.summary: Swift-Arm introduces Kaito's new sparring partner, who is the emperor, and Kaito sees her face for the first time.
Kaito spars with the emperor and she disarms him, smiling in recognition.
events.quote: held both wooden blades to his neck before he even had time to steady himself.

events.summary: Katsumasa, a Futurist, meets Kaito in a palace garden, sends a crane drone, and gives Kaito one.
events.quote: "Here. From one person the system failed to another."

events.summary: Kaito tells Katsumasa that his parents died after the lab accident and the unapproved med-tech.
events.quote: "My dad was arrested. He died in prison, and my mom died not long after."

events.summary: Light-Paws tells Kaito there will be no more sparring lessons and that he must choose a path, and Kaito refuses to be a samurai.
events.quote: "I don't want to be a samurai,"

events.summary: Light-Paws reveals the emperor told her of Kaito's ideas, and Kaito turns his back on his mentor.
events.quote: "What you mean," Kaito replied bitterly, "is that I have no place here."

events.summary: An alarm sounds in the palace and Kaito races over the rooftops to the emperor's chambers.
events.quote: Kaito took the fastest route to the emperor's chambers.

events.summary: Kaito finds Kyodai writhing in distress and the emperor missing.
events.quote: But now Kyodai writhed in the water, lashing at the fog like she was hurting and confused.

events.summary: Kaito sees the man with the metal arm rise from the fog beside Kyodai.
events.quote: and a metal arm that pulsed with purple energy, the ends forming a monstrous claw.

events.summary: Kaito chases the intruder over the rooftops, but the man uses power over technology to yank Kaito from the roof and escapes.
events.quote: Kaito felt his wrist tug, and then he was yanked from the roof

events.summary: Kaito discovers the emperor is gone, and the Imperials blame the Uprisers.
events.quote: he realized the emperor was gone, too.

events.summary: Light-Paws suggests the Futurists are responsible and refuses to listen to Kaito's account.
events.quote: "Perhaps the Futurists are responsible for this.

events.summary: Light-Paws orders Kaito to his room, and Kaito resolves to leave the palace and search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm.
events.quote: He would search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm.

relations.quote: Light-Paws was their teacher, but she was also the closest thing they had to a guardian.
Swift-Arm ran the elite Golden-Tail Academy for Imperial samurai.
And eventually, that's what they became.

relations.note: speaks and channels herself through the emperor
relations.quote: The guardian spirit of Kamigawa only spoke through the emperor
Not that the emperor's advisor would approve of Kaito's extracurricular activities.
